values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

note: Rustic state forest campground in a hilly, wooded setting on Long Lake, 8 mi N of Cadillac via Long Lake Rd/Old US-131 (Wexford Co); managed by Mitchell State Park. Pike and panfish; the lake can run low for paddling in late summer. ORVs and snowmobiles may ride between the campground and the Long Lake Motorcycle Trail, Missaukee Junction Trail and Grand Traverse Motorcycle Trail. --Claude
